title: Fix PDF export to generate actual PDF files using jsPDF

requirements.summary: Rewrite pioneersPdfExport.ts to use jsPDF correctly with autoTable for generating actual PDF files
acceptanceCriteria: pioneersPdfExport.ts imports jsPDF from 'jspdf' and imports 'jspdf-autotable'
A new jsPDF instance is created with `new jsPDF()`
A title is added to the PDF using doc.text()
Pioneer data is added as a table using doc.autoTable() with the correct column headers
The file is saved via doc.save('pioneers-report.pdf')
No HTML string generation or blob-based download logic remains in the file
Clicking the Export to PDF button on the Pioneers page downloads an actual .pdf file that opens in a PDF viewer

file_operations.description: Replace the entire HTML-based export implementation with jsPDF library usage. Import jsPDF from 'jspdf' and 'jspdf-autotable' at the top. Create a new jsPDF instance, add a title using doc.text('Pioneers Report', x, y), format pioneer data into rows with columns for Name, Service Year, Total Hours, Average Hours, and Status, then call doc.autoTable() with proper column definitions and body data. Finally, save the file using doc.save('pioneers-report.pdf'). Remove all HTML string generation, createHTMLContent function, blob creation, and anchor-based download logic. Keep the existing data preparation logic that calculates total hours and averages.
